title: Concept ontology (computed)
rights: Derived: Nave’s Topical Bible and Torrey’s New Topical Textbook (public domain), Easton’s Bible Dictionary (public domain), Strong’s dictionaries (Open Scriptures, CC BY-SA), KJV Strong’s tags (public domain). Edges are computed from those sources and from the installed works; no editorial interpretation is added.
method: Nodes: topic headings merged on slug, Easton entries attached by slug or alias. Lexical profile: Strong’s numbers over a node’s verses weighted by inverse verse frequency, stop-list of the most common lemmas. Edges: Nave see-also; co-occurrence (≥3 shared verses and Jaccard ≥0.02 or ≥12 shared); shared leading lemma; installed works by unigram/bigram of the head name (generic words and names under four letters skipped).
rightsNote: Lexical profiles derive from the Open Scriptures Strong’s data (CC BY-SA 3.0); this package is therefore CC BY-SA. Attribute Open Scriptures, Nave, Torrey, Easton.
